newsitem.title: USA: Peerless expects favorable Q4 comparison.
newsitem.headline: Peerless expects favorable Q4 comparison.

text.p: Peerless Industrial Group Inc, which posted improved third-quarter results, said it anticipates favorable fourth-quarter comparisons this year.

"The fourth quarter has traditionally been the strongest quarter for Peerless," said chief executive officer William Spell in a statement. "Last year traction sales were slow until January, when the East was hit by several large storms.
"Therefore, we expect that we will see favorable comparisons in the fourth quarter this year," he noted.
Earlier, Peerless posted third-quarter earnings of $0.09, up from $0.01 a year ago.
